name: hcapp_setEventAttendence
description: Sets attendance state for a single hasher at an event. Can resolve the hasher by @hasherId or by @qrScanText (QR code). Supports direct HEM lookup via @hemId. Blocks removal from run if a payment exists. Updates Event.Hares string when @isHare changes. Returns one of two adHoc rowset shapes depending on whether the call was a QR scan. Delegates to syncEventAdminData or syncUserData.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to update. When @qrScanText is provided, may be resolved from PublicEventId.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Hasher to update. Defaults to calling user if null and @qrScanText is null. Overwritten from QR scan if @qrScanText provided.

parameters.name: attendenceState
parameters.description: New state. Must be 0-40. 0-19=not at run, 20-29=on trail, 30+=On Inn.

parameters.name: returnUserRecords
parameters.description: Default 0. When 1, delegates to syncUserData instead of syncEventAdminData.

parameters.name: qrScanText
parameters.description: QR code string (UQR: prefix). When provided, resolves @hasherId and returns extended adHoc rowset.

parameters.name: hemId
parameters.description: Direct HEM lookup. If provided, @hasherId is resolved from it. Must match @eventId — mismatch returns error.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2 for null userId, null eventId, invalid attendenceState, unknown hasherId, mismatched hemId/eventId, existing payment blocking removal. errorType=3 for auth failure.

rowsets.name: AdHocScanResult
rowsets.description: Returned when @qrScanText is provided. Richer than the non-scan version.

columns.name: userMessage
columns.description: Human-readable attendance message. Note column is 'userMessage' here vs 'serverMessage' in non-scan.

columns.name: hares
columns.description: Event.Hares — comma-separated string of hare display names.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState, (optionally RsvpState, IsHare)
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — if no existing HEM record
UPDATE HC.Event SET hares — when @isHare changes (STRING_AGG of hare names)

codeSmells.issue: Two incompatible adHoc rowset shapes — different column names for 'serverMessage'
codeSmells.detail: Non-scan path: column is 'serverMessage'. QR-scan path: column is 'userMessage'. Callers must branch on whether they sent a QR scan to know which column name to expect.

codeSmells.issue: @attendenceState validated as 0-40 here vs 20-40 in setBulkEventAttendence
codeSmells.detail: The single-attendence SP allows 0-40 (can un-check users). The bulk SP only allows 20-40. Inconsistent — intentional difference or oversight?

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never rename 'serverMessage' vs 'userMessage' without updating callers for both paths
